props.name: disableSort
props.comment: Hide the sort button on the header. A column with no `source` never sorts.

props.name: sortByOrder
props.comment: The order the first click sorts by (default `"ASC"`).

props.name: headerClass
props.comment: Extra class for the header `<th>` only.

props.name: cellClass
props.comment: Extra class for the body `<td>`s only.

props.name: conditionalClass
props.comment: Extra class for a body `<td>`, computed from its row record.
